title: Assign Jira issues with AI by a teammate’s name
h1: give a jira issue to the teammate you name
description: Ask an AI bot to assign a Jira issue by name or email, use the project default or clear an owner. Handle ambiguous matches before any assignment changes.
answer: **give the issue an owner before it spends another week in limbo.** a bot can find a jira issue, look up the teammate you name and assign it. you can also choose the project default or clear the owner. put a confirmation step in the routing routine; assignments don't wait for sending approval.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: an owner chosen by your routing rule.
what:
**one vague name can send work to the wrong desk.** give the bot the issue and a teammate's name or email. when several people match, have it show who it found before choosing. a separate user search can help.

project default and unassigned mean different things. leaving the person out can clear the owner. if the lookup fails, the bot should stop rather than quietly unassign the issue.
uses: route a new billing bug to the person covering that queue
hand an issue to a new owner after matching the right person
return a misrouted issue to the project default
clear an owner only when the team wants the issue back in the unassigned queue

routine.message: each weekday at 10, find unassigned invoicing issues mentioning 'tax receipt'. propose devin rowe as owner. show the issue titles and the person you found here. if several people match, show them and ask which one i mean. ask me before you change anything. assign only the issues i confirm, then report the result. never clear an owner or substitute another person after a failed lookup.
routine.needs: jira connected with read and write
routine.output:
routing result
inv-51: tax receipt missing for larkspire co.
new owner: devin rowe.
inv-58 remains unassigned; no approval to change it.

steps: connect jira with **read and write** for this bot
name the project, issue rule and teammate; read the matched person’s details
allow only issue search, user lookup and assignment; include the ask-first instruction
open the first issue in jira and read its owner; pause the routine when cover changes
watch: **privacy settings can block name or email searches.** report the missing match instead of choosing someone else.
**missing person is not permission to clear the owner.** stop after a failed lookup.
**keep approval in the routing instruction.** the sending setting covers sends, not jira assignments.
**display names can repeat.** compare the matches before routing work.

faq.q: can i assign a jira ticket using just an email address?
faq.a: **yes, the lookup accepts email or display name.** privacy settings can block it. have the bot show the person it finds.

faq.q: is the default assignee the same as unassigned?
faq.a: **no, they lead to different queues.** default chooses the project’s default owner. unassigned removes the current one.

faq.q: will it ask me before reassigning tickets?
faq.a: **only if you tell it to ask.** jira assignments are app changes. the sending setting does not hold them.

sources.label: Metal docs: sending and approval settings

steps: connect jira with read and write
name one issue and its intended owner
ask to see the person found before any change
confirm, then read the saved owner in jira

mistakes.fix: ask to see the matched person when names overlap.
include a confirmation step before assignments in the routine.

tip.text: if the person search fails, leave the issue with its current owner.
